item.title: Deaths among unhoused LA County residents fell in 2024, marking first decline on record
item.description: About 2,208 people experiencing homelessness died in the county that year, 300 fewer than the previous year, according to the report from the county Department of Public Health. The post Deaths among unhoused LA County residents fell in 2024, marking first decline on record appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: Metal thievery is plunging Long Beach streets into darkness. Residents are anxious for a fix.
item.description: There's been a surge in copper wire theft, and residents say it's sometimes taken months or years to get stripped streetlights fixed. The post Metal thievery is plunging Long Beach streets into darkness. Residents are anxious for a fix. appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: Storm Burger, a popular burger joint from Inglewood, wants to revive fast food in Long Beach
item.description: Its owners say they “missed that old school fast food vibe, where people can bring their families, have a good experience at the restaurant and actually enjoy being here, while also getting a good meal for the same price.” The post Storm Burger, a popular burger joint from Inglewood, wants to revive fast food in Long Beach appeared first on Long Beach Post.
